In this insightful episode of Bharat Ki Bhoomi, Manoj Agarwal Ji explains that industrial growth is never driven by price alone. It is driven by planning, expertise, and infrastructure built around long-term business success.

He shares how plot sizes should be designed according to modern machinery requirements, helping businesses avoid unnecessary land wastage and extra investment. He also highlights that not every developer has the same expertise, and specialised industrial park builders create ecosystems where industries can truly grow.

According to Manoj Agarwal Ji, lower-priced land may look attractive initially, but without proper sizing, connectivity, and infrastructure, long-term progress often gets delayed.

Watch the full conversation to understand what separates ordinary land from growth-ready industrial opportunities.

શ્રી ગ્રુપ (Shree Group), દેવમ (Devam), અને ક્રિષ્ના ડેવલપર્સ (Krishna Developers) દ્વારા પ્રસ્તુત "Shree Devam Business Park" લાવ્યા છે તમારા વ્યવસાયના વિકાસ માટે સૌથી પ્રીમિયમ લોકેશન.

૩૦૦ ફૂટના મેગા રીંગરોડથી બિલકુલ નજીક હોવાને કારણે અહીં તમને મળશે અદભૂત કનેક્ટિવિટી અને ટ્રાન્સપોર્ટેશનની ઉત્તમ સુવિધા, જે તમારા બિઝનેસને આપશે એક નવી સ્પીડ.

✨ પ્રોજેક્ટની વિશેષતાઓ:
📍 અદભૂત લોકેશન: ૩૦૦ ફૂટ રીંગરોડથી માત્ર ૨૦૦ મીટરના અંતરે.
🏢 સરનામું: TP 54 – FP 130/2, કુંભારીયા - નિયોલ કેનાલ રોડ, નિયોલ.

આજના આધુનિક યુગમાં તમારા બિઝનેસને સ્માર્ટ અને વ્યૂહાત્મક લોકેશન પર સેટ કરવા માટે આજે જ સંપર્ક કરો!

A liver transplant is a highly structured surgical procedure where the diseased liver is replaced with a healthy donor liver 🏥

Every step of the procedure requires precision, expertise, and careful coordination 👨‍⚕️✨

🔍 Key steps involved in liver transplant:
✔️ Diseased liver is carefully removed
✔️ Healthy donor liver is implanted in position
✔️ Blood vessels 🩸 and bile duct are connected
✔️ Liver function is monitored immediately after surgery 📊

📌 A liver transplant is not just about replacing an organ — it is about restoring essential liver function and improving quality of life 🌿

🩺 When Does a Liver Transplant Become Necessary? 💚

A liver transplant is considered when the liver is no longer able to function properly and symptoms begin affecting daily life 🏥

⚠️ Recognising these warning signs early can help in timely evaluation and treatment.

🚨 Common signs may include:
💧 Persistent swelling in the abdomen (Ascites)
🟡 Yellowing of eyes or skin (Jaundice)
😓 Frequent fatigue and weakness
🏥 Repeated hospital admissions for liver-related issues
🧠 Confusion or changes in mental clarity
🍽️ Poor appetite and unexplained weight loss

📌 These symptoms may indicate that the liver is struggling to cope and needs urgent medical attention.

⏳ Timely evaluation helps doctors decide when a liver transplant may become necessary.

👨‍⚕️ For expert evaluation and guidance, consult Chhattisgarh’s renowned Surgical Gastroenterologist, Dr. Ajit Mishra.

💬 Early diagnosis can improve treatment outcomes and quality of life.

🩺 Understanding Liver Transplant Surgery 💚

A liver transplant is a highly structured surgical procedure where the diseased liver is replaced with a healthy donor liver 🏥

Every step of the procedure requires precision, expertise, and careful coordination 👨‍⚕️✨

🔍 Key steps involved in liver transplant:
✔️ Diseased liver is carefully removed
✔️ Healthy donor liver is implanted in position
✔️ Blood vessels 🩸 and bile duct are connected
✔️ Liver function is monitored immediately after surgery 📊

📌 A liver transplant is not just about replacing an organ — it is about restoring essential liver function and improving quality of life 🌿

🩺 Different Types of Liver Transplant Procedures 💚

Liver transplant can be performed using different donor sources depending on availability and the patient’s clinical condition 🏥

Each approach is carefully selected to ensure the best possible outcome 👨‍⚕️✨

🔍 Common types of liver transplant include:
✔️ Living donor transplant 🫀 — where a part of the liver is donated
✔️ Deceased donor transplant 🙏
✔️ Split liver transplant in selected cases 🔬
✔️ Choice of transplant depends on timing ⏳ and donor suitability

📌 The right approach is always decided based on detailed evaluation of both patient and donor factors.

👨‍⚕️ For expert evaluation and guidance, consult Chhattisgarh’s renowned Surgical Gastroenterologist, Dr. Ajit Mishra.
